Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border payments are partially functional. MVola signed a partnership with MFS Africa in October 2023 to enhance international remittance services and complied with the GSMA Mobile Money API for international remittances in September 2023. Orange Money and Airtel Money also support international remittances. Madagascar's mobile money network was specifically cited in the SIIPS 2024 executive summary as one of the systems supporting cross-border payments. However, cross-border infrastructure still struggles with high fees, slow settlement, and limited currency options. A national switch for full bank-to-e-wallet cross-border interoperability is not yet deployed. The e-Ariary RFQ document (2021) included cross-border capability as a design requirement.

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Madagascar has a partially deployed digital payment ecosystem with multiple active mobile money systems (Orange Money, Airtel Money, MVola) interoperable since 2016, an operational RTGS for high-value interbank settlement, and a retail clearing system. The country is NOT listed as having a full national instant payment system (IIPS) in the AfricaNenda SIIPS 2025 report, but does appear as a 'mobile money' system in advanced/nascent categories. A 10-month e-Ariary (CBDC) pilot was launched in May 2025. The Central Bank is piloting domestic instant payments but these are not yet widely rolled out. Madagascar mobile money was referenced in SIIPS 2024 as one of 11 systems at the 'advancing' inclusivity level. Cash still dominates, especially in rural areas.
